scope: Independent review of final human-model narrative and JSON for primary metadata fidelity, source/content boundaries, same-article lineage, missing fields, decision inference and closure.

source_checks.read_scope: Direct complete metadata record; title, institution, degree date, DOI, file link, release note, generic VoR and specific Accepted Manuscript labels independently checked.
Targeted exact-PMID indexed metadata check confirms 2026 Jan8 issue date, volume/page and same Brain DOI. No new full-paper or supplement read.

findings.detail: The independently reopened NDL/IRDB record matches the title, Kyoto institution, degree date, thesis DOI and named official full-text link. Its content is metadata; the files do not represent it as manuscript text.

The January 2026 degree and issue dates and July 2026 manuscript-release note are separated from the July 2025 online Brain publication. The record identifies the same underlying DOI; no additional biological cohort is counted.

Generic VoR and the specific Accepted Manuscript rights note are both retained. These are differing metadata labels; the actual PDF version remains unverified and no source corruption or full-version reconciliation is asserted.

Genotypes, donor/clone/batch/tissue counts, force outcome, rescue timing and BLU pharmacology newly verified from the unread manuscript remain null. Assembly-versus-established-deficit adjudication stays false.

The narrative and ledger report no recovered fuller exact model report or human BLU result from the finite named-program update. They expressly reject universal absence and treat access failure as an information limit.

Kora, Lionello/Tedesco and JCI prior findings are distinguished from freshly read metadata or indexed fragments. The manuscript manifestation, article mirror and conference record do not inflate independent efficacy counts.
A public manuscript or model catalog does not establish available material, assay transfer, a project price or budget validation. The update asserts neither new ready access nor infeasibility.
Existing bounded human qualification remains affirmative. A source-retrieval negative does not create a biological downgrade, new universal gate, financial return or cross-portfolio rerank.

The documented finite publication update closes at the unavailable content boundary, preserves prior generic search closures and has all six activity fields false. The review did not repeat failed manuscript accesses.

Strict JSON parses; five unique sources, five evidence rows and four claim decisions resolve all references. New outcome counts, null fields, base commit, candidate and local narrative link are coherent.
